column1: Jake McCarthy stands out as the most reliable pick today, leading off at home with a strong recent hit rate and a clear platoon advantage against Casey Mize. Fernando Tatis Jr. also offers steady production atop the order in a hitter-friendly park, making him a solid secondary option. Cody Bellinger and Pete Crow-Armstrong round out the top choices, each benefiting from favorable matchups and lineup spots for consistent hit opportunities.
